how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:special-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:915:obj:0: Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule and Foror's brand ice cream.

rows.quest:915:details:1: I had it once a long time ago when I was at the Shimmering Flats race track, but I heard that they might be selling them in town now! Please? Pretty please? With Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream on top??!?!

rows.quest:915:completion:0: Mmmmmmmmm! I love their strawberry ice cream! If there's one thing Tigule and Foror know to do, it's make ice cream!
rows.quest:915:completion:1: Thank you very much ⟦12⟧ - this is the best treat ever!

rows.quest:1558:obj:0: Take the orphan to the Stonewrought Dam in ⟦E16⟧. You should take him to the middle of the dam so he can see out over the giant waterfall.
rows.quest:1558:details:0: ⟦E17⟧ is where all the dwarves and gnomes live. Near there is a place called ⟦E16⟧, and the dwarves built a HUGE dam there. They say it's one of the biggest things anyone's ever made. Wow!
rows.quest:1558:details:1: Could you take me to ⟦E16⟧ and see the dam there, please? I think it is the Stone... um... Stonewrench Dam? Stonewrought? It's big - that's for sure. I'd like to look out over the big waterfall. I promise I won't lean over too far!
rows.quest:1558:completion:0: WOW - the dam was WAY bigger than I thought! I could barely hear myself talk from the sound of all the rushing water! Hey, do you think it would ever run out of water? Man, what would happen if that damn ever broke! WOW, that would be scary!
rows.quest:1558:completion:1: Thanks for taking me to see the dam. That was very kind of you. I told you I wouldn't lean over too far!
